message.content:
Below is a quick‑look list of the **federal public holidays that create “long weekends” in Canada for 2023**.  
(If you need province‑specific holidays—e.g., Family Day in Ontario, St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland, etc.—you’ll have to add those separately.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Observed (if weekend) | Long‑weekend span (inclusive) | Notes |
|---------|-------------|-----------------------|------------------------------|-------|
| New Year’s Day | Sunday Jan 1 | Monday Jan 2 (observed) | **Jan 1 – Jan 3** | 3‑day weekend (Sunday‑Monday‑Tuesday) |
| Good Friday | Friday Apr 7 | – | **Apr 7 – Apr 9** | Friday + weekend |
| Victoria Day | Monday May 22 | – | **May 20 – May 22** | Weekend + Monday |
| Canada Day | Saturday Jul 1 | Monday Jul 3 (observed) | **Jul 1 – Jul 3** | 3‑day weekend (Saturday‑Sunday‑Monday) |
| Labour Day | Monday Sep 4 | – | **Sep 2 – Sep 4** | Weekend + Monday |
| Thanksgiving | Monday Oct 9 | – | **Oct 7 – Oct 9** | Weekend + Monday |
| Remembrance Day | Friday Nov 11 | – | **Nov 11 – Nov 13** | Friday + weekend |
| Christmas Day | Monday Dec 25 | – | **Dec 23 – Dec 25** | Weekend + Monday |
| Boxing Day | Tuesday Dec 26 | – | – | Not a long weekend (falls on Tuesday) |

### How to interpret the table

* **Observed**: If a holiday falls on a weekend, Canada usually observes it on the following Monday. That Monday becomes part of the long weekend.
* **Long‑weekend span**: The range includes the weekend days (Saturday & Sunday) plus any observed holiday day.  
  * For example, Canada Day 2023 falls on Saturday, so the long weekend is Saturday Jul 1 – Monday Jul 3.
* **Three‑day weekends**: When a holiday falls on a Sunday (or Monday) and is observed on Monday, you get a 3‑day stretch (e.g., New Year’s Day 2023).

### Province‑specific notes

| Province/territory | Extra long‑weekend holidays in 2023 |
|--------------------|-------------------------------------|
| Alberta | Family Day (Feb 20) – long weekend Feb 18‑20 |
| British Columbia | Family Day (Feb 20) – long weekend Feb 18‑20 |
| Manitoba | Family Day (Feb 20) – long weekend Feb 18‑20 |
| Ontario | Family Day (Feb 20) – long weekend Feb 18‑20 |
| Saskatchewan | Family Day (Feb 20) – long weekend Feb 18‑20 |
| Newfoundland & Labrador | St. Patrick’s Day (Mar 17) – long weekend Mar 17‑19 |
| Quebec | Saint‑Jean‑Baptiste Day (Jun 24) – long weekend Jun 22‑24 |
| ... | (Other provinces have their own holidays; check local calendars.) |

> **Tip for your app**: Store the holiday dates in a database and flag those that fall on a Friday or Monday (or are observed on Monday). Then generate the long‑weekend ranges automatically.

Let me know if you’d like a more detailed, province‑by‑province breakdown or if you need the data in a specific format (JSON, CSV, etc.).
